# 📋 Hand off Dominatrix shift

- **Checklist types:** Morning Dominatrix, Evening Dominatrix
- **Area:** Private infrastructure
- **When:** At the end of each Dominatrix shift

## What you need

- 📦 Camp Issue Log — At the Dominatrix station. On-playa log for unresolved task, supply, safety, and service issues. Do not record private incident or health details.
- 📦 Generated Checklists — At the Dominatrix station and each applicable work station. Printed shift checklists generated from the canonical task checklist types.
- 🔧 Camp Radios — Private infrastructure area. Rechargeable handheld radios used for camp operations.

## Steps

1. Review every BLOCKED, ESCALATED, and incomplete checklist line.
2. Record each unresolved issue and next action in 📦 Camp Issue Log.
3. Record proposed instruction changes in 📦 Camp Issue Log without editing the printed task card or checklist.
4. Brief the incoming Dominatrix on each unresolved issue and next action.
5. Return the radio to 🔧 Camp Radios.

## PASS when

- Every unresolved issue and proposed documentation change is recorded.
- The incoming Dominatrix received the handoff.
- The radio is returned and charging or fully charged.

## Finish

- Before marking PASS, return each used item to its location and leave it ready for the next person.
- Collect all MOOP.
- If an item, instruction, or solution is missing or unclear, ask the Dominatrix.

### Leave items ready

- **📦 Camp Issue Log:** Every unresolved operational issue has a current status and next action.
- **📦 Generated Checklists:** Each completed line shows status, initials, and completion time; unresolved lines identify the next action.
- **🔧 Camp Radios:** Every returned radio is fully charged or visibly charging. No damaged or unusually hot battery is charging.

## Who to ask

Camp Lead
